description: The bar chart illustrates the performance of three LLaMA-2 model variants — LLaMA-2-7B, LLaMA-2-13B, and LLaMA-2-70B — on the CoLeG-E benchmark (%), under four different supervised fine-tuning (SFT) conditions: no SFT (light blue with diagonal stripes), SFT on dataset D₀ (orange with horizontal stripes), SFT on D₀ and D₁ (lavender with diagonal stripes), and SFT on D₀, D₁, and D₂ (salmon pink with no pattern). The vertical axis represents CoLeG-E score in percentage, ranging from 0 to 50 with tick marks at intervals of 10. For each model size, performance improves monotonically as more datasets are added to SFT: LLaMA-2-7B scores approximately 4% without SFT, rising to ~20% with D₀, ~28% with D₀+D₁, and ~30% with D₀+D₁+D₂. LLaMA-2-13B follows a similar trend, starting at ~8% without SFT and reaching ~39% with full SFT. LLaMA-2-70B shows the highest scores overall, starting at ~26% without SFT and peaking at ~50% with full SFT. The chart visually confirms that both increasing model scale and expanding the SFT dataset contribute to improved performance on CoLeG-E, with the largest gains observed when both factors are combined.
